name: pi-procedure
description: Claude Code-style procedure orchestration: an LLM-callable `procedure` tool that runs a deterministic JS script fanning out one-shot subagents via agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase()/log(), with a journal-backed resume, saved procedures (/procedures), a live expandable progress tree with agent thinking/tool activity above the editor (alt+e), and an alt+w stop brake. Subagent tool calls are pi-safety gated over procedure:confirm-request.
